cat > .ci-comparison/pr1133/compare.py <<'PY'
"""Build an exhaustive quantity inventory and comparative PDF from CI outputs.

Uses the installed postgkyl Python API. Each output quantity is shown at its
last common frame and at the frame with the largest normalized coefficient
change (when different). Every file is inventoried; no read errors are hidden.
"""
import argparse
import csv
import re
import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.backends.backend_pdf import PdfPages
import numpy as np
import postgkyl as pg


def read(path, physical=False):
    data = pg.load(path)
    if physical:
        if data.ctx.get('value_form') == 'quad':
            data = data.represent(to='modal')
        if data.ctx.get('value_form') in ('modal', 'nodal'):
            data = data.interpolate(num_interp=2)
    values = np.asarray(data.values)
    coords = [0.5*(x[1:]+x[:-1]) if len(x) == values.shape[i]+1 else x
              for i, x in enumerate(data.grid)]
    return data, coords, values


def compatible(a, b):
    da, xa, va = a
    db, xb, vb = b
    return (va.shape == vb.shape and len(xa) == len(xb)
            and all(np.array_equal(x, y) for x, y in zip(xa, xb))
            and np.isclose(da.ctx.get('time', 0), db.ctx.get('time', 0),
                           rtol=1e-10, atol=1e-14))


def textpage(pdf, title, lines):
    for start in range(0, max(1, len(lines)), 42):
        fig = plt.figure(figsize=(11.7, 8.3))
        fig.text(.05, .94, title, fontsize=15)
        fig.text(.05, .89, '\n'.join(lines[start:start+42]), fontsize=9,
                 va='top', family='monospace', wrap=True)
        pdf.savefig(fig)
        plt.close(fig)


def plot_pair(pdf, title, pa, pb, notes):
    try:
        a, b = read(pa, True), read(pb, True)
    except Exception as exc:
        textpage(pdf, title, notes + ['PLOT ERROR: '+str(exc)])
        return False
    da, xa, va = a
    db, xb, vb = b
    same = compatible(a, b)
    if va.ndim != vb.ndim or va.shape[-1] != vb.shape[-1]:
        textpage(pdf, title, notes + [f'Incompatible shapes: {va.shape}, {vb.shape}'])
        return False
    ndim = va.ndim-1
    for first in range(0, va.shape[-1], 3):
        count = min(3, va.shape[-1]-first)
        fig, axes = plt.subplots(count, 3, figsize=(14, 3*count+1.3), squeeze=False)
        for row, comp in enumerate(range(first, first+count)):
            u, v = va[..., comp], vb[..., comp]
            ax = axes[row]
            if ndim == 1:
                ax[0].plot(xa[0], u, label='main', lw=1.5)
                ax[0].plot(xb[0], v, '--', label='branch', lw=1)
                ax[0].legend(fontsize=7)
                ax[0].set_title(f'Component {comp}: overlay')
                ax[0].set_xlabel('Time' if da.ctx.get('value_form') not in ('modal','nodal','quad') else 'Coordinate 0')
                if same:
                    delta = v-u
                    ax[1].plot(xa[0], delta)
                    ax[1].set_title('Branch - main')
                    scale = max(float(np.max(np.abs(u))), float(np.max(np.abs(v))), 1e-300)
                    ax[2].plot(xa[0], delta/scale)
                    ax[2].set_title('Difference / global max magnitude')
                else:
                    ax[1].text(.1,.5,'Different coordinates or times;\nno pointwise subtraction.',transform=ax[1].transAxes)
                    ax[2].axis('off')
            else:
                # Show the last two coordinates; select remaining indices at
                # the full-domain maximum difference, not an arbitrary cut.
                idx = np.unravel_index(np.nanargmax(np.abs(v-u)), u.shape)[:-2] if same and np.any(np.isfinite(v-u)) else tuple(s//2 for s in u.shape[:-2])
                idx_b = idx if same else tuple(s//2 for s in v.shape[:-2])
                us, vs = u[idx], v[idx_b]
                finite = np.concatenate((us[np.isfinite(us)], vs[np.isfinite(vs)]))
                lo, hi = (float(finite.min()), float(finite.max())) if finite.size else (0., 1.)
                if lo == hi:
                    hi = lo + max(abs(lo)*1e-12, 1e-300)
                for axis, xs, arr, name in [(ax[0],xa,us,'main'),(ax[1],xb,vs,'branch')]:
                    im = axis.pcolormesh(xs[-2], xs[-1], arr.T, shading='nearest', vmin=lo, vmax=hi, rasterized=True)
                    fig.colorbar(im, ax=axis, shrink=.8)
                    axis.set_title(f'Component {comp}: {name}')
                    axis.set_xlabel(f'Coordinate {ndim-2}')
                    axis.set_ylabel(f'Coordinate {ndim-1}')
                if same:
                    delta = vs-us
                    lim = max(float(np.nanmax(np.abs(delta))), 1e-300)
                    im = ax[2].pcolormesh(xa[-2], xa[-1], delta.T, shading='nearest', cmap='RdBu_r', vmin=-lim, vmax=lim, rasterized=True)
                    fig.colorbar(im, ax=ax[2], shrink=.8)
                    ax[2].set_title('Branch - main')
                else:
                    ax[2].text(.1,.5,'Different grids or times;\nno pointwise subtraction.',transform=ax[2].transAxes)
                coords = ', '.join(f'x{k}={xa[k][j]:.5g}' for k,j in enumerate(idx))
                ax[0].text(0,-.28,'Slice: '+(coords or 'full 2D domain'),transform=ax[0].transAxes,fontsize=7)
            if same:
                finite = np.isfinite(u) & np.isfinite(v)
                maxabs = float(np.max(np.abs(v[finite]-u[finite]))) if finite.any() else float('nan')
                scale = max(float(np.max(np.abs(u[finite]))),float(np.max(np.abs(v[finite]))),1e-300) if finite.any() else float('nan')
                ax[2].set_xlabel(f'Full domain: max |delta|={maxabs:.3g}; normalized={maxabs/scale:.3g}\nNonfinite main/branch: {np.sum(~np.isfinite(u))}/{np.sum(~np.isfinite(v))}',fontsize=7)
            for axis in ax:
                axis.tick_params(labelsize=7)
        fig.suptitle(title+'\n'+f't(main)={da.ctx.get("time", "history")}; t(branch)={db.ctx.get("time", "history")}',fontsize=10)
        fig.tight_layout(rect=(0,0,.99,.93))
        pdf.savefig(fig, dpi=110)
        plt.close(fig)
    return True


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--baseline', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--candidate', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--expected', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--baseline-sha', required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--candidate-sha', required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--test', action='append', default=[])
    args = parser.parse_args()
    args.output.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    tests = set(args.test)
    if not tests:
        tests.update(line.split('#')[0].strip().split('/')[-1] for line in args.expected.read_text().splitlines() if line.split('#')[0].strip())
        for dbpath in args.candidate.glob('*/regressiondb'):
            with sqlite3.connect(f'file:{dbpath}?mode=ro',uri=True) as conn:
                guid = conn.execute('select guid from RegressionMeta order by rowid desc limit 1').fetchone()
                if guid:
                    tests.update(row[0].split('/')[-1] for row in conn.execute('select name from RegressionData where guid=? and status<=0 and status>=-6',(guid[0],)))
    inventory = []
    issues = []
    with PdfPages(args.output/'comparisons.pdf') as pdf:
        textpage(pdf,'PR #1133: main versus branch',[
            'Baseline: '+args.baseline_sha,'Candidate: '+args.candidate_sha,
            f'Tests selected: {len(tests)}','',
            'Every .gkyl quantity is inventoried, including unchanged outputs.',
            'Each quantity: last common frame and largest normalized coefficient-change frame.',
            'All physical components are plotted. Modal data: 2 samples per cell per axis.',
            'For >2 dimensions, last two axes are plotted at the largest-difference slice.',
            'Full-domain error statistics accompany each component; slices are labeled.',
            'No subtraction for unequal grids or snapshot times. Histories use native times.',
            'Missing/unreadable files are reported explicitly. See inventory.csv for all frames.',
            'These comparisons show changes, not proof that all changes are correct.',
        ])
        for test in sorted(tests):
            print(test,flush=True)
            aa = list(args.baseline.glob(f'*/creg-accepted/cpu_serial/{test}'))
            bb = list(args.candidate.glob(f'*/creg-runs/cpu_serial/{test}'))
            if len(aa)!=1 or len(bb)!=1:
                msg = f'{test}: missing or ambiguous output directory ({len(aa)}, {len(bb)})'
                issues.append(msg)
                textpage(pdf,test,[msg])
                continue
            af = {x.name:x for x in aa[0].glob('*.gkyl')}
            bf = {x.name:x for x in bb[0].glob('*.gkyl')}
            groups = {}
            for name in sorted(af.keys()|bf.keys()):
                row = dict(test=test,file=name,status='ok',max_abs='',normalized='',frame='',time_main='',time_branch='')
                m = re.match(r'(.*)_(\d+)\.gkyl$',name)
                quantity,frame = (m[1],int(m[2])) if m else (name.removesuffix('.gkyl'),-1)
                row['frame'] = frame
                try:
                    if name not in af or name not in bf:
                        raise ValueError('missing in '+('main' if name not in af else 'branch'))
                    a,b = read(af[name]),read(bf[name])
                    row['time_main'],row['time_branch']=a[0].ctx.get('time',''),b[0].ctx.get('time','')
                    if compatible(a,b):
                        u,v=a[2],b[2]
                        if not np.all(np.isfinite(u)) or not np.all(np.isfinite(v)):
                            row['status']='nonfinite'
                        delta=float(np.nanmax(np.abs(v-u)))
                        scale=max(float(np.nanmax(np.abs(u))),float(np.nanmax(np.abs(v))),1e-300)
                        row['max_abs'],row['normalized']=delta,delta/scale
                    else:
                        row['status']='grid, shape, or time mismatch'
                    groups.setdefault(quantity,[]).append(row)
                except Exception as exc:
                    row['status']=str(exc)
                inventory.append(row)
                if row['status']!='ok':
                    issues.append(test+'/'+name+': '+row['status'])
            textpage(pdf,test,[f'{len(af)} baseline files; {len(bf)} candidate files; {len(groups)} common quantities.']+
                     [r['file']+': '+r['status'] for r in inventory if r['test']==test and r['status']!='ok'])
            for quantity, rows in sorted(groups.items()):
                last=max(rows,key=lambda r:r['frame'])
                numeric=[r for r in rows if isinstance(r['normalized'],float) and np.isfinite(r['normalized'])]
                worst=max(numeric,key=lambda r:r['normalized']) if numeric else last
                selected=[last]+([worst] if worst['file']!=last['file'] else [])
                for row in selected:
                    ok=plot_pair(pdf,test+'\n'+row['file'],af[row['file']],bf[row['file']],[])
                    if not ok:
                        issues.append(test+'/'+row['file']+': plot failed')
        textpage(pdf,'Coverage exceptions',issues or ['None'])
    with (args.output/'inventory.csv').open('w') as out:

def render(job):

    command=[sys.executable,str(root/'compare.py'),'--baseline',str(base),'--candidate',str(cand),'--output',str(dest),'--mode',mode,'--test',test]
    with (dest/'render.log').open('w') as log:
        result=subprocess.run(command,env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    if result.returncode:return dest,f'{mode}/{test}: renderer exit {result.returncode}'
    marker.write_text(json.dumps(sha)+'\n')
    return dest,None

4. Shared node construction: coordinates are computed from global cell indices,
   avoiding rank-local accumulation of floating-point increments. Internal MPI
   boundaries therefore use the same coordinate arithmetic as a serial mesh.

   global boundaries. X-point mapping setup restores all three saved mappings
   and derivative callbacks; mapping slopes are evaluated at computational
   coordinates rather than already-mapped coordinates.
